benefits.details: Comprehensive insurance with flexible coverage, OPD wallet, mental wellness support, pet insurance, and an option to include in-laws as dependents.

benefits.details: Equal parental leave for all caregivers, including same-sex partners, adoptive & surrogate parents, IVF support, gender reaffirmation surgery, and hormone replacement therapy.

benefits.name: Hybrid Working Model
benefits.details: Work flexibly with a hybrid model, 3 days in-office, 2 days remote, ensuring balance, collaboration, and productivity.

benefits.name: Comprehensive Leave Policies
benefits.details: A variety of leaves, including casual, unlimited wellness, vacation, recharge, family care, and pet adoption leaves, to support work-life balance.

benefits.name: Cafeteria
benefits.details: Our campus features a full cafeteria with a wide array of meal choices, complemented by popular outlets like Barista, and Hatti Kaapi. To further support our employees, we provide a company-sponsored Pluxee card with a fixed monthly meal allowance.
